title: Seal wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#8fd6e8'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='20' ry='11' fill='#d6f4fb'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='22' fill='#8fd6e8'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#d6f4fb'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='4.5' ry='3.2' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M44 57 Q50 61 56 57' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sunglasses lenses -->
  <rect x='29' y='35' width='17' height='12' rx='5' fill='#7a3fbf'/>
  <rect x='54' y='35' width='17' height='12' rx='5' fill='#7a3fbf'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <path d='M33 38 L37 38 L33 44 Z' fill='#c9a6ee'/>
  <path d='M58 38 L62 38 L58 44 Z' fill='#c9a6ee'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='46' y='39' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2a8f'/>
  <!-- temple arms -->
  <rect x='24' y='38' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2a8f'/>
  <rect x='70' y='38' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a2a8f'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='53' r='1' fill='#6a9aa8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='53' r='1' fill='#6a9aa8'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='56' r='1' fill='#6a9aa8'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='56' r='1' fill='#6a9aa8'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='72' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#6cc2d8' transform='rotate(20 20 72)'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='72' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#6cc2d8' transform='rotate(-20 80 72)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M78 84 Q88 84 84 90 Q80 88 78 84 Z' fill='#6cc2d8'/>
</svg>
